subject: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — trial plan & scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@finlytics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — next steps (post-discovery)

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the great discovery earlier — appreciate you walking us through Finlytics' current search & summarization flow and the top priority use cases. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary objectives: improve SEC filing summarization accuracy, reduce token cost on long-doc queries, and add reranking for results to boost precision on paid reports.
- Success criteria (what we heard): 1) 10-15% improvement on summary ROUGE/QA pass rate for SEC filings; 2) 30% lower per-session token cost via caching/quantization; 3) integration that fits into your nightly batch pipeline.

Next step: we recommend an evaluation kickoff where we set up a short trial (2-4 weeks) with a focused prompt set and eval harness so we can measure against those criteria. Proposed agenda (30-45 min):

1) Quick intro + success criteria alignment (5-10 min)
2) Redwood demo — serving/runtime config + demo of batching/caching behaviors (10-15 min)
3) Technical kickoff — evaluation plan, prompt set, data access and security (10-15 min)
4) Next steps & responsibilities / calendar sync (5 min)

Available slots I can propose: Tue 2027-04-06 10:00-10:45 PT, Wed 2027-04-07 11:00-11:45 PT, or Thu 2027-04-08 14:00-14:45 PT. Please let me know which works (or share a preferred time) and who from your side should attend — we suggest your ML lead + infra engineer.

Connor (cc'd) will run the technical deep dive and own the evaluation setup. Neha will coordinate the prompt set & eval metrics.

Attached: initial evaluation plan template (we'll flesh it out after kickoff).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evaluation-plan-v1.pdf (PDF, 324 KB)

From: Priya Desai <priya@finlytics.com>

Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@finlytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T11:03:00-07:00

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the clear agenda. That aligns with what we discussed.

We can do Tue 2027-04-06 10:00 PT — that works for our ML lead (Ravi) and me. Ravi will also want to review the SOC2/data access details up-front; I attached our standard vendor questionnaire in case Redwood's security team wants to start.

Two quick asks before the kickoff:
- Can you include a short list of the exact data access requirements and expected artifacts (S3 access vs. sample uploads)?
- Can Connor share an initial list of the prompt set / eval metrics you plan to use so we can sanity-check before the call?

If you confirm Tue 4/6 10a PT, I'll share a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Platform
Finlytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@finlytics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — confirmed Tue 4/6 10a PT

Perfect — confirmed for Tue 2027-04-06 10:00-10:45 PT. Calendar invite looks great, thanks Priya.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Data access: for the kickoff we only need a small sample set (5-10 SEC filings + metadata) uploaded to a secure S3 bucket or shared as password-protected files in a shared drive. We will not keep long-term copies; retention and KMS key usage can be configured per your security team. I'll include a short one-page data access summary in the shared doc before the call.
- Prompt set & eval metrics: Connor will attach a draft during the thread — it will include 20-30 prompt templates across summarization and reranking, plus an initial eval harness (accuracy checks + cost tracking).

Attendees from Redwood: Marissa (AM/sales), Connor (Solutions Engineer — demo & eval lead), Neha (Solutions Engineer — prompt/eval owner). Suggested Finlytics attendees: Priya (Head of Platform), Ravi (ML lead), and one infra engineer to discuss S3/network.

Next actions:
- Connor to post draft prompt set + eval plan to the shared doc (before EOD 4/4).
- Neha to add data access summary to the doc (before the call).
- Priya to send calendar invite for Tue 4/6 10a PT

Thanks all — will see you on the 6th.

Best,
Marissa

> On Apr 2, 2027, at 11:03 AM, Priya Desai <priya@finlytics.com> wrote:
> > Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the clear agenda. That aligns with what we discussed.

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics evaluation kickoff — prompt set & eval draft (shared)

Hi Priya — thanks for confirming the time. I'm attaching a first draft of the evaluation plan and prompt set to give you something to review before the call. High-level notes:

- Prompt set: 28 templates split across SEC summarization (abstractive & extractive), result reranking, and targeted Q&A for financial statements. Each template includes an expected metric (QA pass/fail, ROUGE-L, or rerank precision@5).
- Eval harness: we'll run the harness on a held-out sample you provide and report on both quality and token-cost metrics; we'll also include per-route latency percentiles so you can evaluate SLA feasibility.
- Data access & security: sample upload to S3 with per-file encrypted keys; we will not persist data beyond the trial unless you opt-in. Full details in the attached plan.

I'll post the draft to the shared doc and attach a PDF here for quick review. If you have any immediate questions I can hop on a quick 15-min pre-call with Ravi.

Regards,
Connor
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evaluation-plan-v1.pdf (PDF, 324 KB)
